summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry ("\x1b]0;{title}\x07") and Control.title(title), which passes a two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, placed after set_alt_screen; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
